content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to request a small adjustment to the terms. - Regarding the clause "$ 115,250.00      Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date                                     of this Agreement.", payment terms of Net 90 days create cash flow delays for you, so I propose that The Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
